FOREIGN_MEMORY.doc: Bounded native buffers and scoped borrowed SML array copies.

members.name: buffer
members.doc: A checked native allocation, view or explicitly bounded pointer view.

members.name: direction
members.doc: Input snapshots, copied outputs, or both.

members.name: argument
members.spec: type argument = {array : Word8Array.array, offset : int, length : int, direction : direction}
members.doc: One array range passed as a native pointer during a scoped call.

members.name: Bounds
members.doc: A negative size or range beyond its known object extent.

members.name: allocate
members.doc:
`allocate length` creates retained zeroed storage; its caller releases it.

Native bridge failures propagate.

**Raises** `Bounds` for a negative size.

members.name: fromBytes
members.doc: `fromBytes bytes` makes a retained native copy, released by its caller.

members.name: release
members.doc:
`release buffer` releases its registry identity after all views close.

The native bridge rejects stale storage and live dependents.

members.name: length
members.doc: `length buffer` returns its annotated byte extent.

members.name: raw
members.doc: `raw buffer` returns its opaque pointer identity for raw native calls.

members.name: slice
members.spec: val slice : buffer * int * int -> buffer
members.doc:
`slice (buffer, offset, length)` creates a sharing view retaining its owner.

**Raises** `Bounds` for an invalid range.

members.name: pointer
members.spec: val pointer : {pointer : RuneForeign.resource, length : int} -> buffer
members.doc:
`pointer {pointer, length}` bounds an annotated native pointer.

The caller establishes the foreign extent and ownership. Releasing this
view never calls a native deallocator; it retains the pointer identity.

members.name: read
members.spec: val read : buffer * int * int -> string
members.doc: `read (buffer, offset, length)` copies a checked range to SML.

members.name: write
members.spec: val write : buffer * int * string -> unit
members.doc: `write (buffer, offset, bytes)` updates storage visible through all views.

members.name: terminated
members.spec: val terminated : {buffer : buffer, unitBytes : int} -> string
members.doc:
`terminated {buffer, unitBytes}` reads through a native NUL code unit.

Unit width is one or two bytes; the terminator must fit in the extent.
Reads stop at the terminator, avoiding a copy beyond the foreign string.

**Raises** `Bounds` if no complete terminator is present.

members.name: withBytes
members.doc: `withBytes bytes body` scopes one copied native input buffer.

members.name: withArrays
members.doc:
`withArrays arguments body` supplies native views in argument order.

Ranges of the same SML array share one backing allocation, preserving
overlap and pointer aliasing. Inputs are snapshots; outputs copy back on
every returning path. Output bytes supersede callback-side SML writes.
Temporary views close first; outputs then copy back before allocations
close.

FOREIGN_OWNER.doc: Explicit ownership and borrowed-use scopes for native pointers.

members.name: owner
members.doc: A shared owner identity; copies observe the same closing/closed state.

members.name: destructor
members.spec:
type destructor = {call : RuneForeign.resource,
  arguments : RuneForeign.resource -> RuneForeign.argument list, failure : RuneForeign.failure}
members.doc: A prepared native destructor and its argument projection.

members.name: Closed
members.doc: An operation on an already retired native identity.

members.name: Busy
members.doc: An attempt to close an active borrower or a destructor in progress.

members.name: AlreadyOwned
members.doc: A second owner for the same live native address.

members.name: Failed
members.doc: A native destructor returned its annotated failure status.

members.name: adopt
members.spec: val adopt : {pointer : RuneForeign.resource, destructor : destructor} -> owner
members.doc:
`adopt {pointer, destructor}` takes ownership of a native-owned pointer.

The pointer must come from an ownership-annotated foreign result.
Failure leaves responsibility with the caller. Destruction also checks
native provenance and rejects Rune-owned storage before native entry.

members.name: isClosed
members.doc: `isClosed owner` refreshes its shared state from the native registry.

members.name: withBorrow
members.doc:
`withBorrow owner body` guards one synchronous use of its raw identity.

The borrowed identity must not outlive this use without an explicit raw
retention contract. Native views additionally retain their source.

**Raises** `Closed` or `Busy` when the owner cannot be borrowed.

members.name: close
members.doc:
`close owner` invokes its destructor and retires its native identity.

A failed native destructor preserves ownership for retry and raises
`Failed` with the raw status/error. Native bridge failures propagate.

**Raises** `Closed`, `Busy` or `Failed`.

members.name: inScope
members.doc:
`inScope (scope, owner)` registers at-most-once scoped destruction.

An already closed owner needs no second destructor call. Cancel the
returned cleanup ticket to transfer responsibility beyond this scope.
